newsitem.title: USA: Gucci rises ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Gucci rises ahead of results.

text.p: Luxury goods maker Gucci Group NV rose strongly on Thursday, boosted by speculation of stronger-than-expected 1996 results, traders and analysts said.
Gucci American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose 3-3/4 to 73-1/2 by mid-afternoon, bucking an overall decline in ADRs. Volume was almost 810,000 shares, more than twice normal daily trade.
"This is strong for a market that's basically down," a trader said.
Gijsbert Groenewegen, an analyst for Europe Co Ltd in London, said Gucci would report its 1996 results next Thursday and he thought they would be better than the consensus estimate.
"There is a consensus that the last three months might be quite good for Gucci and everybody is getting excited," he said. "So the momentum is building up."
The I/B/E/S consensus estimate for the fiscal year ended Jan 31, 1996, is 4.69 guilders, or $2.47, a share. The company reported earnings of 3.15 guilders, or $1.65, a share for the previous year.
He said the ADRs' Thursday price translated into about 139 guilders, above Gucci's resistance level of 136 to 137 guilders on the Amsterdam exchange.
